questions.stem: A bag has 40 marbles and 15% of them are red. How many are red?
Four probabilities are 0.1, x, 2x and 0.3, and they must add up to 1. What is x?
questions.explain: The sum is 0.4 + 3x = 1, so 3x = 0.6 and x = 0.2.

questions.stem: Two different dice are rolled. How many outcomes are there in total?
questions.explain: Each die has 6 faces and the choices multiply: 6 × 6 = 36.

questions.stem: In how many ways can you choose 2 people from 5 (order does not matter)?
A coin is tossed 3 times. In how many of the 8 outcomes is there at least one head?
questions.explain: Count the complement: only TTT has no head. So 8 − 1 = 7 outcomes have at least one head.
